title: Toolkit: exact pricing, legality oracle and free-endpoint retime for P104-family words (no kappa)
body:
## Summary

Toolkit: exact pricing, legality oracle and free-endpoint retime for P104-family words (no kappa). This package claims no kappa and no new word. It packages the tooling behind the recent P104 retime line (PR5551, PR5553, PR5561) as one command, `tk`, with a regression suite that reproduces their published numbers.

Package: `research/p104-designer-toolkit/` (task card `scalar-to-moment`, recorded as `scope_status: changed`; the package ships verification and retime tooling rather than pursuing scalar A2 contractions).

## What it contains

- `tk price`: exact invoice and Decimal-50 root, crossing interval, side constraints and budgets; `--real` runs the unmodified PR5545 verifier stack with only census/claim literals patched. Reproduces PR5545 .0030411718, PR5551 .0030415312, PR5553 .0030428243, PR5561 .0030814243 (starts-only .0030768800) and the published real-stack crossing intervals.
- `tk check`: legality oracle listing all violations with rule string, event, register role and frame; three illegal mutants are localised in the suite.
- `tk retime` / `tk evretime`: exact-lattice retime with named freedoms and the event-level retime with free ADD placement (CP-SAT, optional). `retime 5551 --free starts,finals` reproduces PR5561; `evretime 5561` gives .003081500768 (+7.6e-8).
- `tk diff`, `tk sens`, `tk pricer`, `tk hops`: word diff (5551 -> 5561: scalar program identical, 170 stops deleted), invoice marginals, rank-r owned-pivot pricing generalising PR5392 (reproduces its RESULT; rank-8 synthetic +7.2248e-5 / +1.4449e-4), and the delivery-program counter (916 / 2797).
- `tk gen` (hub-partition generator) is workspace-only and not replayed here.

`infra/`, `pricer/`, `words/` (byte-identical to the PRs, hashes in `SOURCES.json`) and `inputs/pr5545-source-closure.tar.gz` (used unmodified) make the package self-contained apart from reading `research/native-transpose-owned` (PR5392) in place. Nothing is written into the checkout.

## Conditional on

No claim is made. The retime commands assume the verifier's free helper start/final frames, which is not a maintainer-approved contract; the toolkit reports the gain but cannot decide admissibility. Generic CI has no ortools, so the retime is verified there from its shipped output (diff, exact price and legality); `tests/regress.py --solver` re-derives it where ortools exists.

## Verification

- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-designer-toolkit --check-only`
- Replay (two commands, each under 600 s): `tests/regress.py --quick --pricer --real 5553` and `tests/regress.py --real 5551,5561`: exact kappa of all five words, localised mutants, the 5551 -> 5561 diff, sens table, PR5392 pricer results, and the real-stack crossings of PR5551, PR5553 and PR5561.
